evidence.text: The entry gives 學 the current Mandarin reading xué (ㄒㄩㄝˊ). Its writing note says 覺 uses 學省, a reduced form of 學, in its upper part; it separately gives 學's historical Shuowen account. This dictionary statement concerns graphic structure, not evidence that current pronunciations establish an ancient sound relationship.
evidence.title: [A01001] 學 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.text: The entry gives 覺 two current Mandarin readings: jué (ㄐㄩㄝˊ) and jiào (ㄐㄧㄠˋ). Its Shuowen analysis is 从見、學省聲: 見 plus a reduced 學 used phonographically. The reading relevant to the requested current-reading comparison is jué; jiào is a separate reading.
evidence.title: [A03774] 覺 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

search_audit.outcome: Performed one search for the two specified official Taiwan MOE records and opened both. 學 is listed as xué; 覺 as jué and jiào. The 學 entry explicitly describes 覺 as using reduced 學 at the top, while the 覺 entry records 學省聲 in its Shuowen analysis.
